label: Division 293 tax rate
quote: The rate of Division 293 tax is 15%.
pattern: The rate of Division 293 tax is ([\d.]+%)
notes: The page states no start date. The 15% rate is set by s 5 of the Superannuation (Sustaining the Superannuation Contribution Concession) Imposition Act 2013 (No. 87, 2013), and Division 293 applies from the 2012-13 income year (Income Tax (Transitional Provisions) Act 1997 s 293-10, inserted by the Tax and Superannuation Laws Amendment (Increased Concessional Contributions Cap and Other Measures) Act 2013, No. 82, 2013, Sch 3 item 38): https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2013A00087/asmade
